title_cn: 科技让我们更快乐了吗
content_en: Technology has made our lives easier in many ways. We can talk to friends across the world, find information quickly, and finish daily tasks with less effort. However, having more technology does not always mean having more happiness. Many people spend hours looking at screens and comparing their lives with others online. This can make them feel lonely or unhappy. Technology is useful, but we need to control how we use it. Spending time outdoors, talking face to face, and enjoying simple activities are still important. Perhaps the key is not having more technology, but using it in a better way.
content_cn: 科技在很多方面让我们的生活变得更加轻松。我们可以和世界各地的朋友交流，快速查找信息，并且用更少的精力完成日常任务。然而，拥有更多科技并不总是意味着拥有更多快乐。许多人花费数小时盯着屏幕，并在网上拿自己的生活与别人比较。这可能让他们感到孤独或不快乐。科技很有用，但我们需要控制自己的使用方式。到户外活动、面对面交流以及享受简单的活动仍然很重要。也许关键不在于拥有更多科技，而在于更好地使用它。

sentences.sentence_en: Technology has made our lives easier in many ways.
sentences.sentence_cn: 科技在很多方面让我们的生活变得更加轻松。
sentences.explanation: make + 宾语 + 形容词，表示使某人或某物变得怎样。这里使用现在完成时，强调科技带来的持续影响。

sentences.sentence_en: We can talk to friends across the world, find information quickly, and finish daily tasks with less effort.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们可以和世界各地的朋友交流，快速查找信息，并且用更少的精力完成日常任务。
sentences.explanation: 三个动词短语并列，描述科技带来的便利。across the world 表示遍布世界各地。

sentences.sentence_en: However, having more technology does not always mean having more happiness.
sentences.sentence_cn: 然而，拥有更多科技并不总是意味着拥有更多快乐。
sentences.explanation: having more technology 是动名词短语，在句中作主语。not always 表示并非总是如此。

sentences.sentence_en: Many people spend hours looking at screens and comparing their lives with others online.
sentences.sentence_cn: 许多人花费数小时盯着屏幕，并在网上拿自己的生活与别人比较。
sentences.explanation: spend time doing something 是固定结构，表示花时间做某事。comparing 与 looking 并列。

sentences.sentence_en: This can make them feel lonely or unhappy.
sentences.sentence_cn: 这可能让他们感到孤独或不快乐。
sentences.explanation: make + 宾语 + 动词原形，feel 在这里作宾语补足语。

sentences.sentence_en: Technology is useful, but we need to control how we use it.
sentences.sentence_cn: 科技很有用，但我们需要控制自己的使用方式。
sentences.explanation: how we use it 是宾语从句，说明需要控制的具体内容。

sentences.sentence_en: Spending time outdoors, talking face to face, and enjoying simple activities are still important.
sentences.sentence_cn: 到户外活动、面对面交流以及享受简单的活动仍然很重要。
sentences.explanation: 三个动名词短语共同作主语，因此谓语使用 are。face to face 表示面对面地。

sentences.sentence_en: Perhaps the key is not having more technology, but using it in a better way.
sentences.sentence_cn: 也许关键不在于拥有更多科技，而在于更好地使用它。

chunks.text: the key is not having more technology,
chunks.meaning: 关键不在于拥有更多科技

chunks.text: using it in a better way.

sentences.explanation: not...but... 表示不是……而是……，用于强调真正重要的选择。

expressions.example: Exercise helps us in many ways.
People across the world use smartphones.
He spends hours reading online.
We should talk face to face sometimes.
We can solve this problem in a better way.

questions.question: What is one possible negative effect of spending too much time online?
questions.answer: Feeling lonely
questions.explanation: 文章提到，长时间看屏幕和与别人比较可能让人感到孤独。

questions.question: The passage says that more technology always brings more happiness.
questions.explanation: 文章明确指出，拥有更多科技并不总是意味着更加快乐。

questions.question: What does the passage suggest we should do?
questions.answer: We should control how we use technology and spend time on real-life activities.
questions.explanation: 文章建议合理使用科技，同时重视户外活动和面对面交流。

quality_check.notes: 句子拆分按原文顺序排列，分块可还原原句。

content_en: The way people work is changing quickly. In the past, most workers went to an office every day and followed a fixed schedule. Today, technology allows many people to work from home or choose flexible hours. Some jobs are also being changed by artificial intelligence. This may create new opportunities, but it can also make certain jobs disappear. In the future, people may need to learn new skills throughout their careers. Communication, creativity, and problem-solving will become even more valuable. Instead of worrying about every change, we should stay curious and be ready to learn.
content_cn: 人们的工作方式正在迅速改变。过去，大多数员工每天都要去办公室，并遵循固定的时间安排。如今，科技让许多人可以在家工作，或者选择灵活的工作时间。一些工作也正在受到人工智能的改变。这可能创造新的机会，但也可能让某些工作消失。未来，人们可能需要在整个职业生涯中不断学习新技能。沟通能力、创造力和解决问题的能力将变得更加有价值。与其担心每一次变化，我们不如保持好奇，并做好学习的准备。

sentences.sentence_en: The way people work is changing quickly.
sentences.sentence_cn: 人们的工作方式正在迅速改变。
sentences.explanation: the way people work 表示人们工作的方式。现在进行时强调变化正在发生。

sentences.sentence_en: In the past, most workers went to an office every day and followed a fixed schedule.
sentences.sentence_cn: 过去，大多数员工每天都要去办公室，并遵循固定的时间安排。

chunks.meaning: 并遵循固定的时间安排

sentences.explanation: 描述过去的习惯和情况时使用一般过去时。fixed 是形容词，表示固定的。

sentences.sentence_en: Today, technology allows many people to work from home or choose flexible hours.
sentences.sentence_cn: 如今，科技让许多人可以在家工作，或者选择灵活的工作时间。

chunks.meaning: 或者选择灵活的工作时间

sentences.explanation: allow somebody to do something 表示允许或使某人能够做某事。

sentences.sentence_en: Some jobs are also being changed by artificial intelligence.
sentences.sentence_cn: 一些工作也正在受到人工智能的改变。
sentences.explanation: are being changed 是现在进行时的被动语态，表示某些工作正在被改变。

sentences.sentence_en: This may create new opportunities, but it can also make certain jobs disappear.
sentences.sentence_cn: 这可能创造新的机会，但也可能让某些工作消失。
sentences.explanation: make + 宾语 + 动词原形，表示使某事发生。may 和 can 都表示可能性或能力。

sentences.sentence_en: In the future, people may need to learn new skills throughout their careers.
sentences.sentence_cn: 未来，人们可能需要在整个职业生涯中不断学习新技能。
sentences.explanation: need to do something 表示需要做某事。throughout 表示贯穿整个过程。

sentences.sentence_en: Communication, creativity, and problem-solving will become even more valuable.
sentences.sentence_cn: 沟通能力、创造力和解决问题的能力将变得更加有价值。
sentences.explanation: 三个名词并列作主语。even more 用于加强比较程度，表示更加。

sentences.sentence_en: Instead of worrying about every change, we should stay curious and be ready to learn.
sentences.sentence_cn: 与其担心每一次变化，我们不如保持好奇，并做好学习的准备。
sentences.explanation: instead of 后接名词或动名词。stay curious 表示保持好奇的状态。

expressions.example: People traveled differently in the past.
I work from home twice a week.
Artificial intelligence is changing many industries.
People continue learning throughout their careers.
We should be ready to face new challenges.

questions.question: What has technology made possible for many workers?
questions.answer: Working from home
questions.explanation: 文章提到，科技让许多人可以在家工作或选择灵活的工作时间。

questions.question: Artificial intelligence may create opportunities and also change or remove some jobs.
questions.explanation: 文章同时提到了新机会和某些工作消失的可能性。

questions.question: Which skills may become more valuable in the future?
questions.answer: Communication, creativity, and problem-solving.
questions.explanation: 文章直接列出了这三种重要能力。

quality_check.notes: 使用自然的职场和科技主题表达。

content_en: The world is changing faster than ever before. New technologies, growing cities, and global communication are changing how people live and work. Some changes make life more convenient, while others bring new challenges. For example, people can travel more easily, but cities may become more crowded. Information is easier to find, but false information can spread quickly. These changes affect people in different ways. We cannot stop the world from changing, but we can learn to understand it. By staying open-minded and learning new things, we can prepare ourselves for the future.
content_cn: 世界正在以前所未有的速度发生变化。新技术、不断发展的城市以及全球交流正在改变人们的生活和工作方式。一些变化让生活更加便利，而另一些则带来了新的挑战。例如，人们可以更轻松地旅行，但城市也可能变得更加拥挤。信息更容易获取，但虚假信息也可能迅速传播。这些变化以不同的方式影响着人们。我们无法阻止世界变化，但可以学着理解它。通过保持开放的心态并学习新事物，我们能够为未来做好准备。

sentences.sentence_en: The world is changing faster than ever before.
sentences.sentence_cn: 世界正在以前所未有的速度发生变化。
sentences.explanation: faster than ever before 是常用比较表达，表示比以往任何时候都更快。

sentences.sentence_en: New technologies, growing cities, and global communication are changing how people live and work.
sentences.sentence_cn: 新技术、不断发展的城市以及全球交流正在改变人们的生活和工作方式。

chunks.meaning: 人们的生活和工作方式

sentences.explanation: how people live and work 是宾语从句，说明正在发生改变的内容。

sentences.sentence_en: Some changes make life more convenient, while others bring new challenges.
sentences.sentence_cn: 一些变化让生活更加便利，而另一些则带来了新的挑战。
sentences.explanation: while 在这里表示对比，连接两种不同的情况。

sentences.sentence_en: For example, people can travel more easily, but cities may become more crowded.
sentences.sentence_cn: 例如，人们可以更轻松地旅行，但城市也可能变得更加拥挤。

chunks.meaning: 人们可以更轻松地旅行

sentences.explanation: become + 形容词表示变得怎样。more crowded 是比较级。

sentences.sentence_en: Information is easier to find, but false information can spread quickly.
sentences.sentence_cn: 信息更容易获取，但虚假信息也可能迅速传播。
sentences.explanation: information 是不可数名词。false information 指不真实或错误的信息。

sentences.sentence_en: These changes affect people in different ways.
sentences.sentence_cn: 这些变化以不同的方式影响着人们。
sentences.explanation: affect 是动词，表示影响；不要与名词 effect 混淆。

sentences.sentence_en: We cannot stop the world from changing, but we can learn to understand it.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们无法阻止世界变化，但可以学着理解它。
sentences.explanation: stop somebody or something from doing something 表示阻止某人或某事做某事。

sentences.sentence_en: By staying open-minded and learning new things, we can prepare ourselves for the future.
sentences.sentence_cn: 通过保持开放的心态并学习新事物，我们能够为未来做好准备。

chunks.meaning: 我们能够让自己做好准备

sentences.explanation: by + 动名词表示通过某种方式。prepare oneself for 表示为……做好准备。

expressions.example: Technology is developing faster than ever before.
Many activities are free, for example, walking in the park.
People learn in different ways.
Good planning can stop small problems from growing.
Learning new skills helps us prepare for the future.

questions.question: What is one challenge mentioned in the passage?
options: People having no access to travel
questions.answer: Cities becoming more crowded
questions.explanation: 文章指出，城市可能因为发展而变得更加拥挤。

questions.question: The passage says all changes make life better.
questions.explanation: 文章说明变化既带来便利，也带来挑战。

questions.question: How can people prepare for the future?
questions.answer: By staying open-minded and learning new things.
questions.explanation: 文章最后一句给出了明确建议。

quality_check.notes: 围绕全球变化、信息传播和适应能力展开。

content_en: Nature gives us the air we breathe, the water we drink, and the food we eat. However, human activities are putting pressure on the natural world. Forests are being cut down, rivers are becoming polluted, and many animals are losing their homes. Protecting nature is not only the responsibility of governments. Every person can make a difference through daily choices. We can save water, reduce plastic waste, and use public transportation more often. We can also support businesses that care about the environment. Small actions may seem unimportant, but together they can create meaningful change.
content_cn: 大自然为我们提供呼吸的空气、饮用的水以及食用的食物。然而，人类活动正在给自然界带来压力。森林正在被砍伐，河流正在受到污染，许多动物正在失去家园。保护自然不仅是政府的责任。每个人都可以通过日常选择产生积极影响。我们可以节约用水、减少塑料垃圾，并更多地使用公共交通。我们也可以支持那些关注环境的企业。小小的行动看起来可能并不重要，但汇聚起来就能带来有意义的改变。

sentences.sentence_en: Nature gives us the air we breathe, the water we drink, and the food we eat.
sentences.sentence_cn: 大自然为我们提供呼吸的空气、饮用的水以及食用的食物。
sentences.explanation: 三个定语从句分别修饰 air、water 和 food，省略了关系代词 that。

sentences.sentence_en: However, human activities are putting pressure on the natural world.
sentences.sentence_cn: 然而，人类活动正在给自然界带来压力。
sentences.explanation: put pressure on 是固定表达，表示给……施加压力。

sentences.sentence_en: Forests are being cut down, rivers are becoming polluted, and many animals are losing their homes.
sentences.sentence_cn: 森林正在被砍伐，河流正在受到污染，许多动物正在失去家园。
sentences.explanation: are being cut down 是现在进行时被动语态；are becoming polluted 表示正在变得受到污染。

sentences.sentence_en: Protecting nature is not only the responsibility of governments.
sentences.sentence_cn: 保护自然不仅是政府的责任。
sentences.explanation: Protecting nature 是动名词短语，作句子的主语。

sentences.sentence_en: Every person can make a difference through daily choices.
sentences.sentence_cn: 每个人都可以通过日常选择产生积极影响。
sentences.explanation: make a difference 表示产生影响、带来改变。

sentences.sentence_en: We can save water, reduce plastic waste, and use public transportation more often.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们可以节约用水、减少塑料垃圾，并更多地使用公共交通。
sentences.explanation: 三个动词短语并列，列举保护环境的实际行动。

sentences.sentence_en: We can also support businesses that care about the environment.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们也可以支持那些关注环境的企业。
sentences.explanation: that care about the environment 是定语从句，修饰 businesses。

sentences.sentence_en: Small actions may seem unimportant, but together they can create meaningful change.
sentences.sentence_cn: 小小的行动看起来可能并不重要，但汇聚起来就能带来有意义的改变。
sentences.explanation: seem + 形容词表示看起来怎样。together 强调个人行动汇聚后的力量。

expressions.example: Too much traffic puts pressure on the environment.
We should not cut down too many trees.
One small action can make a difference.
I take public transportation to work.
She cares about protecting animals.

questions.question: Which problem is mentioned in the passage?
questions.answer: Rivers becoming polluted
questions.explanation: 文章明确提到河流正在受到污染。

questions.question: Only governments are responsible for protecting nature.
questions.explanation: 文章指出每个人都可以通过日常选择保护自然。

questions.question: Name two actions people can take to protect nature.
questions.answer: Save water and reduce plastic waste.
questions.explanation: 这两项行动都出现在文章列举的环保方式中。

quality_check.notes: 包含环境问题与日常可执行的环保行动。

title_cn: 什么构成一个好的社会
content_en: A good society is not measured only by its wealth or modern buildings. It is also measured by how people treat one another. In a healthy community, people have access to education, medical care, and fair opportunities. They can express their opinions and feel safe in their daily lives. Respect is important because people have different backgrounds and beliefs. A good society also cares for those who need extra support. Everyone has a role to play, from following common rules to helping neighbors. When people trust and support one another, the whole community becomes stronger.
content_cn: 一个好的社会不能只用财富或现代化建筑来衡量。它还取决于人们如何彼此相待。在一个健康的社区里，人们能够获得教育、医疗服务和公平的机会。他们可以表达自己的观点，并在日常生活中感到安全。尊重很重要，因为每个人都有不同的背景和信念。一个好的社会也会关心那些需要额外帮助的人。从遵守共同规则到帮助邻居，每个人都有自己的责任。当人们彼此信任、互相支持时，整个社区就会变得更加团结和强大。

sentences.sentence_en: A good society is not measured only by its wealth or modern buildings.
sentences.sentence_cn: 一个好的社会不能只用财富或现代化建筑来衡量。

chunks.meaning: 它的财富或现代化建筑

sentences.explanation: is measured 是被动语态。not only 在这里强调衡量社会不能只看单一标准。

sentences.sentence_en: It is also measured by how people treat one another.
sentences.sentence_cn: 它还取决于人们如何彼此相待。
sentences.explanation: how people treat one another 是宾语从句。one another 表示彼此。

sentences.sentence_en: In a healthy community, people have access to education, medical care, and fair opportunities.
sentences.sentence_cn: 在一个健康的社区里，人们能够获得教育、医疗服务和公平的机会。
sentences.explanation: have access to 是固定搭配，表示有机会使用或获得某种资源。

sentences.sentence_en: They can express their opinions and feel safe in their daily lives.
sentences.sentence_cn: 他们可以表达自己的观点，并在日常生活中感到安全。
sentences.explanation: express 和 feel 是并列动词，共同受情态动词 can 支配。

sentences.sentence_en: Respect is important because people have different backgrounds and beliefs.
sentences.sentence_cn: 尊重很重要，因为每个人都有不同的背景和信念。
sentences.explanation: because 引导原因状语从句，解释尊重为什么重要。

sentences.sentence_en: A good society also cares for those who need extra support.
sentences.sentence_cn: 一个好的社会也会关心那些需要额外帮助的人。
sentences.explanation: care for 表示关心或照顾。who 引导定语从句，修饰 those。

sentences.sentence_en: Everyone has a role to play, from following common rules to helping neighbors.
sentences.sentence_cn: 从遵守共同规则到帮助邻居，每个人都有自己的责任。

chunks.text: Everyone has a role to play,
chunks.meaning: 每个人都有自己的角色和责任

sentences.explanation: have a role to play 表示有角色或责任。from...to... 在这里表示从某种行为到另一种行为。

sentences.sentence_en: When people trust and support one another, the whole community becomes stronger.
sentences.sentence_cn: 当人们彼此信任、互相支持时，整个社区就会变得更加团结和强大。
sentences.explanation: when 引导时间状语从句。become stronger 表示逐渐变得更强大。

expressions.example: Good friends listen to one another.
Students have access to the library.
Everyone should be able to express an opinion.
We should care for older people.
Every citizen has a role to play.

questions.question: According to the passage, how should we measure a good society?
options: By how people treat one another
questions.answer: By how people treat one another
questions.explanation: 文章强调，一个好的社会还要看人与人之间如何相处。

questions.question: A good society should care for people who need extra support.
questions.explanation: 文章明确提到社会应该关心需要额外帮助的人。

questions.question: Name two things people can do to help build a good society.
questions.answer: Follow common rules and help neighbors.
questions.explanation: 文章第七句给出了这两个例子。

quality_check.notes: 重点呈现公平、尊重、责任与社区互助。

title_en: The Person I Want to Become
content_en: I do not want to become a perfect person. Instead, I want to become someone who keeps learning and treats others with kindness. I hope to be confident without looking down on anyone. I also want to be responsible for my choices and brave enough to face difficulties. Success is important, but it should not be the only goal in my life. I want to have time for family, friends, and the things I enjoy. Becoming this person will take time and effort. I may make mistakes along the way, but I believe every small step can bring me closer to the person I want to be.
content_cn: 我不想成为一个完美的人。相反，我希望成为一个不断学习、善待他人的人。我希望自己有自信，但不会看不起任何人。我也想为自己的选择负责，并拥有面对困难的勇气。成功很重要，但它不应该成为我人生中唯一的目标。我希望有时间陪伴家人、朋友，也有时间做自己喜欢的事情。成为这样的人需要时间和努力。在这个过程中，我可能会犯错，但我相信每一个小小的进步都能让我更接近自己想成为的那个人。

sentences.sentence_en: I do not want to become a perfect person.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我不想成为一个完美的人。
sentences.explanation: want to do something 表示想要做某事。

sentences.sentence_en: Instead, I want to become someone who keeps learning and treats others with kindness.
sentences.sentence_cn: 相反，我希望成为一个不断学习、善待他人的人。
sentences.explanation: who 引导定语从句，修饰 someone。keep doing 表示持续做某事。

sentences.sentence_en: I hope to be confident without looking down on anyone.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我希望自己有自信，但不会看不起任何人。
sentences.explanation: without 后接动名词。look down on 表示轻视、看不起。

sentences.sentence_en: I also want to be responsible for my choices and brave enough to face difficulties.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我也想为自己的选择负责，并拥有面对困难的勇气。
sentences.explanation: be responsible for 表示对……负责。形容词 + enough + to do 表示足够……以至于能够做某事。

title_en: What I Would Tell My Younger Self
title_cn: 我想对年轻时的自己说什么
content_en: If I could talk to my younger self, I would say, 'Do not be afraid of making mistakes.' Life does not always follow the plan we imagine, and that is perfectly normal. I would also remind myself not to spend so much time worrying about what other people think. Their opinions do not define my value. I should take care of my health, enjoy the present, and spend more time with people I love. Most importantly, I would tell myself to be patient. Growing takes time, and there is no need to understand everything at once. Every experience can teach us something useful.
content_cn: 如果我能和年轻时的自己交谈，我会说：“不要害怕犯错。”生活并不总是按照我们想象的计划发展，而这完全正常。我还会提醒自己，不要花太多时间担心别人怎么看我。他们的看法并不能定义我的价值。我应该照顾好自己的健康，享受当下，并花更多时间陪伴我爱的人。最重要的是，我会告诉自己要有耐心。成长需要时间，没有必要一下子理解所有事情。每一次经历都能教会我们一些有用的东西。

title_cn: 如果人生可以重新开始
content_en: If I could start over, I would not try to avoid every mistake. Instead, I would learn from them earlier. I would spend less time trying to impress others and more time discovering what truly matters to me. I would also take better care of my body and build healthier habits. Some opportunities might still pass me by, and some plans might fail. That is part of life. Starting over does not mean creating a perfect past. It means using what we have learned to make better choices today. We cannot change yesterday, but we can decide what to do next.
content_cn: 如果人生可以重新开始，我不会试图避开每一个错误。相反，我会更早地从错误中学习。我会少花一些时间试图给别人留下好印象，而把更多时间用来发现什么对自己真正重要。我也会更好地照顾身体，建立更健康的习惯。一些机会可能仍然会从身边溜走，一些计划也可能失败。这就是生活的一部分。重新开始并不意味着创造一个完美的过去，而是利用我们已经学到的东西，在今天做出更好的选择。我们无法改变昨天，但可以决定接下来要做什么。

title_en: My Definition of a Good Life
content_en: A good life does not have to be rich, famous, or exciting every day. To me, it means having enough time, good health, and people I can trust. It also means doing work that feels meaningful and having the freedom to make my own choices. I enjoy small moments, such as sharing a meal with friends or taking a quiet walk. Of course, life is not always easy, and problems will come. But a good life is not one without difficulties. It is one where we can face them with courage, learn from experience, and still find reasons to be thankful.
content_cn: 美好的生活不一定要富有、出名，也不需要每天都充满刺激。对我来说，它意味着拥有足够的时间、良好的健康，以及值得信任的人。它还意味着从事有意义的工作，并拥有自己做选择的自由。我享受那些简单的时刻，比如和朋友一起吃饭，或者安静地散步。当然，生活并不总是容易的，问题也会出现。但美好的生活并不是没有困难的生活，而是在面对困难时能够保持勇气，从经历中学习，并依然找到值得感恩的理由。

title_cn: 人生中真正重要的是什么
content_en: As we grow older, our idea of what matters in life may change. When we are young, we often focus on money, success, and recognition. These things can be important, but they are not everything. Good health, meaningful relationships, and inner peace also deserve our attention. We should spend time with people who care about us and do things that give us a sense of purpose. Life is too short to waste all our energy chasing things we do not truly need. In the end, what matters most may be how we live, how we treat others, and how much we appreciate each day.
content_cn: 随着年龄增长，我们对人生中什么最重要的看法可能会发生变化。年轻时，我们常常关注金钱、成功和认可。这些东西可能很重要，但它们并不是全部。良好的健康、有意义的人际关系以及内心的平静同样值得我们重视。我们应该花时间陪伴关心我们的人，并做那些能让我们感受到人生意义的事情。人生太短暂了，不应该把所有精力都浪费在追逐那些我们真正并不需要的东西上。归根结底，最重要的可能是我们如何生活、如何对待他人，以及我们有多珍惜每一天。
